anomalies.observed: The net PWM connects the MCU PWM pins U2.6/U3.6, the P-MOSFET gate Q1.1, the NPN collector Q2.3, the pull-up R1.2, and R2.1. The NPN base Q2.1 connects only to R2.2 on net Net-(Q2-B), so the base is tied through R2 to the same PWM net as its collector and the MCU pins.
anomalies.expected: A proper high-side P-MOSFET level shifter would have the MCU pin drive Q2 base through R2, Q2 collector drive the Q1 gate, and R1 pull the Q1 gate up to VCC. The MCU pin must not be directly connected to the Q1 gate/Q2 collector net.

anomalies.impact: The level shifter is defeated: the MCU pin is directly tied to the P-MOSFET gate and is pulled up to VCC through R1. If VCC is the higher input voltage (as required by the LM1117-5.0 regulator), the MCU pin is exposed to an overvoltage, and Q2's self-biased connection prevents the gate from being pulled high to turn off Q1, so the fan power switch may never turn off. This also loads the ISP MISO line and can prevent programming.
